messages.subject: Campus Drive: Haddon Energy - Graduate Engineer Trainee (2026 Batch)
messages.body:
Dear Students,

Haddon Energy is hiring Graduate Engineer Trainees (CTC 9 LPA).
Eligibility: CSE, EEE, ME | CGPA 7.0 and above | No active backlogs.
Register here: https://forms.gle/haddonGET by 11:59 PM, 20 September 2026.

Regards,
Career Office

messages.subject: CANCELLED: Haddon Energy campus drive
messages.body:
Dear Students,

Haddon Energy has withdrawn from campus recruitment this season. The Graduate Engineer Trainee drive is cancelled with immediate effect. We apologize for the inconvenience.

Regards,
Career Office
